name: blocks/studio-services
title: Studio services
description: A premium editorial studio services section with an eyebrow, headline, short introduction and a responsive grid of quietly bordered service cards. Designed for the Journal template's generous whitespace and display-type headings.

ai.useFor: Editorial studio, agency or practice pages that need a calm services overview with three to six short service cards under a clear headline.
ai.avoid: Do not use for pricing tables, product grids, testimonials or long-form process narratives. Do not use to advertise services the studio does not actually offer.
